divergences.name: CraftingDataPacket
divergences.reason: Modeling limitation: the canonical shaped-recipe ingredient (Endstone cerealizer<RecipeIngredient>::SerializedData) is a var_u32-counted string-to-string map followed by zigzag aux value and count, while the pinned ItemDescriptorCount and CloudburstMC readIngredient write a var_u32 descriptor kind, a descriptor-name string, a payload chosen by that name, then the zigzag count. The map is byte-identical for the default and invalid descriptors and diverges for molang and item-tag descriptors. A descriptor discriminated by a string is not expressible in the claim format, so no correction is possible without a manifest schema extension.
divergences.what_would_settle_it: A manifest node kind for string-discriminated unions, or evidence that only default descriptors occur in CraftingData at protocol 2168.

divergences.name: ClientboundUpdateSoundDataPacket
divergences.reason: Open decision, not a guess: commit bbaa61a treats a defaulted Mojang property as always present and deliberately dropped the seven ClientboundUpdateSoundData optional-slot corrections, which is why the canonical slots are bare var_u32 unions. The pinned SoundDataUpdate (OptionalMarshaler, then var_u32 type and payload) and CloudburstMC (writeOptionalNull, then var_u32 and payload) both write a presence bool per slot. Either the defaulted-property rule needs a per-packet exception here or the pinned fork is wrong; the manifest was not changed by the oracle work.
divergences.what_would_settle_it: A ClientboundUpdateSoundData capture at protocol 2168, or a writer trace, decides whether each slot carries a presence bool.
